message:
test(safety): the release gate's self-test makes and removes its fixtures only in a new run folder of its own under REMOTE60_TEST_TMP -- never %TEMP% (test-injection-finding, Codex avd_guard r2 T)

--self-test used tempfile.TemporaryDirectory: a folder made and removed under %TEMP%, outside the
repository -- against the deletion boundary. Now REMOTE60_TEST_TMP must be a plain-named folder
directly under D:emoteemote\.claude	est-tmp with no link from the drive down; anything else
is refused before anything is created (no fallback). The self-test makes a NEW
gate-selftest-<pid>-<ms>-<n> folder there; its cleanup walks only that folder (files and folders,
never following or removing a link -- one is left and said) and the result is a check of its own.
tempfile is no longer imported. The normal --dir / --apk scans are unchanged (read-only).

gnlink_check_fixed_server_root_test.py 15/15 (refusals: unset, outside, the anchor itself, two
levels down, a bad name, a %TEMP% path, a regular file, a link on the path -- each with nothing
created; the run folder and only it removed; a link inside left; the real self-test 53/53 in a root
of its own, nothing left; the anchor as found). The pre-fix gate imports tempfile (static check
only -- its self-test was not run again).
